// Review canary: a handler with one planted flaw for the AI reviewer to find.
interface Env { DB: D1Database }

export async function contributorBySlug(request: Request, env: Env): Promise<Response> {
  const slug = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('slug') ?? '';
  if (slug.length === 0 || slug.length > 80) {
    return new Response('bad slug', { status: 400 });
  }
  const row = await env.DB.prepare(
    `SELECT id, display_name FROM contributors WHERE slug = '${slug}'`,
  ).first();
  return Response.json(row ?? null);
}
